concepts.name: Buffer Solution
concepts.simple_definition: A buffer solution resists changes in pH when small amounts of acid or base are added.
concepts.deep_explanation: It consists of a weak acid and its conjugate base, or a weak base and its conjugate acid. The pH is calculated using the Henderson-Hasselbalch equation.
concepts.real_example: Human blood is a buffer solution containing carbonic acid (H2CO3) and bicarbonate (HCO3-) to maintain pH around 7.4.
concepts.common_confusion: Thinking a buffer can resist any amount of acid. It has a limit called buffer capacity.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: በፈር ሶሉሽን ማለት አነስተኛ አሲድ ወይም ቤዝ ሲጨመርበት የ pH ለውጥን የሚከላከል ድብልቅ ነው።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: ደካማ አሲድ እና ተጓዳኝ ቤዙን ይይዛል። የ pH እሴቱ በሄንደርሰን-ሃሰልባልሽ ቀመር ይሰላል።
concepts.real_example_amharic: የሰው ደም በፈር ሶሉሽን ነው፤ ካርቦኒክ አሲድ እና ባይካርቦኔት በመያዝ የደምን pH 7.4 ላይ ይጠብቃል።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: በፈር ሶሉሽን ማንኛውንም መጠን ያለው አሲድ መቋቋም ይችላል ብሎ ማሰብ። የራሱ ወሰን (buffer capacity) አለው።
